articleBrief.title: Review Mac app remnants without deleting shared files
articleBrief.primaryIntent: Decide what to retain when app leftovers and exact duplicate files appear in a Mac storage audit.
articleBrief.distinctAngle: Separate app-related support data from original/shared files; exact duplicate content does not establish which copy should be removed. DiskMaid documents both remnants and hashing; Breathing Room is the alternate investigate-owner workflow, not a claimed duplicate finder.
outline: Lead with retention-first decision and backups; top real product visual after lead when rights clear
App relationship versus identical contents: two different reasons a file appears
Review candidate path, active projects and backup/restore cost before selecting
Use documented DiskMaid preview/selection with paid-feature boundary; do not invent click steps
If source/ownership remains unclear, investigate rather than delete; bounded Breathing Room alternative and preview/runtime/hosted caveats
Record scan totals separately from actual available-space changes; no recovery guarantee
articleBrief.interactionPass: Handoff a local, non-scanning keep/investigate checklist: active app/project? sole original? shared/synced copy? backup? rebuild cost known? Any unknown means keep/investigate, not delete. No filesystem access, upload or fake savings calculation.
articleBrief.visualPlan: Breathing Room Space preview directly after lead with example-data disclosure; DiskMaid app view later only after rights and pixel review.

comparisonBrief.title: Breathing Room vs DiskMaid
comparisonBrief.primaryIntent: Choose a Mac cleanup/storage approach, not a speed/safety winner.
comparisonBrief.conclusion: DiskMaid documents App Store-distributed cleanup, duplicate detection and app-remnant removal; Breathing Room, which we build, offers a preview investigation/approval workflow with local tools and optional hosted AI. Choose by documented task and release caveats, not unsupported superiority.
comparisonBrief.lengthPolicy: Concise sourced matrix and decision criteria; do not duplicate workflow article or create alternatives doorway.
